question:
Which of the following events was played in National Games 2023?

I. Rowing

II. Rollball
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Games 2023 included a variety of sports to promote athletic talent across the country.
 
• Rowing is a traditional sport that involves racing boats using oars and has been a part of many national and international competitions.
 
• Rollball is a relatively new sport that combines elements of roller skating and basketball and is gaining popularity in India.
 
• The inclusion of both Rowing and Rollball in the National Games 2023 highlights the diversity and inclusivity of the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rowing**

 
 
• Rowing is one of the oldest Olympic sports and requires a high level of endurance, strength, and coordination.
 
• It involves racing boats on water, either in sculling (each rower has two oars) or sweep rowing (each rower has one oar).
 
• Rowing events can be held over various distances, commonly 2000 meters in major competitions.
 
• Rowing is governed by the International Rowing Federation (FISA) globally and by the Rowing Federation of India (RFI) in India.
 
 
 
• **Rollball**
 
 
• Rollball is a team sport played on roller skates, combining elements of basketball, handball, and throwball.
 
• The game is played between two teams of six players each, where the objective is to score goals by throwing the ball into the opponent's net.
 
• It was invented in India by Mr. Raju Dabhade in 2003 and has since gained international recognition.
 
• Rollball is governed by the International Rollball Federation (IRBF) and promotes physical fitness, agility, and teamwork among players.
